items.title: Medical physics: ta'aruf aur istemal hone wali shuaein (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to medical physics (PDF 156-157).

blocks.text: Medical physics physics ki woh shakh hai jo tibb, khaas taur par bimariyon ki tashkhees aur ilaj, mein physics ke usool aur tareeqe laagu karti hai. Yeh physics ko tibbi science se jor kar aisi technologies banati aur istemal karti hai jin se doctors insani jism ke andar dekh aur mareezon ka mehfooz aur mo'assar ilaj kar sakte hain. Yeh tibbi imaging ki durusti barhati, shuaon ke khatre kam karti aur ilaj behtar karti hai. Hospitalon aur tashkhees ke markazon mein yeh X-ray imaging, ultrasound, CT scans aur PET scans mein use hoti hai, jin se doctors operation ke baghair haddi ke toot'ne, rasoliyon (tumours) aur andaruni aza ka pata lagate hain. Yeh chapter piezoelectric effect aur ultrasound, X-rays ki paidawar aur istemal, CT scanning aur PET batata hai.
Medical physics mein istemal hone wali shuaein

Shua (radiation) lehron ya zarrat ki shakal mein khala ya maddah se tawanai ki muntaqili hai. Medical physics mein yeh zyada tar tashkhees (imaging) aur ilaj mein use hoti hai. Ise ionising ya non-ionising mein taqseem kiya jata hai. Ionising shua mein atoms se electrons nikal kar ions banane ke liye kafi tawanai hoti hai; non-ionising mein nahi. Tibb mein ionising shuaon ki misalein X-rays, gamma rays aur positrons (radioactive tracers se) hain; X-rays aur gamma rays maddah se photoelectric effect aur Compton scattering ke zariye amal karti hain. Non-ionising ki misalein ultrasound lehrein aur radio lehrein hain, jo maddah se milne par mun'akis, munhatif ya jazb hoti hain.

X-rays aam taur par haddiyon aur andaruni aza ki tasveer ke liye use hoti hain; gamma rays nuclear medicine, jaise PET scans, aur zyada nufooz (penetrating power) ki wajah se cancer ke ilaj mein use hoti hain. Ultrasound ionising shuaon ke baghair naram tissues ki jaanch, pet ke bachche ki nigrani aur andaruni aza ke mutale mein mehfooz tareeqe se use hota hai. Radio lehrein MRI mein use hoti hain, jahan yeh atomic nuclei se amal kar ke nuqsan-deh shuaon ke baghair naram tissues ki tafseeli tasaveer banati hain.

blocks.prompt: X-rays, ultrasound, gamma rays aur radio lehron ko ionising ya non-ionising mein taqseem karein.
blocks.explanation: Ionising: X-rays aur gamma rays. Non-ionising: ultrasound aur radio lehrein.

items: Medical physics tashkhees aur ilaj mein physics laagu karti.
Ionising (X-rays, gamma rays, positrons) electrons nikal sakti; non-ionising (ultrasound, radio lehrein) nahi.
